extracted.name: Easy Liver Pâté
extracted.description: This liver pâté is made with Braunschweiger, a smoked version of liverwurst. It is perfect for gatherings or parties. Seasonings may be adjusted to taste.
instruction_lines: Mix together sausage, cream cheese, milk, and onion in a medium bowl. Season with Worcestershire sauce, chili powder, sugar, and garlic, and mix until well blended.
Wrap in plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, until firm.
